about: Compose options table. One row per opt-in build option; the page renders it, sends it to /api/generate and reads the estimate hints from it. To add an option, add one row. api.field is the generate body field (network_options or exports) and api.key the name the engine accepts (a network option key, or an EXPORT_NAMES entry); tests/test_build_options.py checks every row against the engine. Time: one run with all four exports on took 54 s against 45 s without (1.7M packets); per-export times were not measured separately, so no per-row time is claimed. The two flow exports together took 50 s against 45 s without (one run, 1.7M packets); not split per export.

groups.label: Network options
groups.lead: Opt-in changes to how the capture is framed on the wire. Off by default, and a default capture is unchanged.

groups.label: Exports
groups.lead: Extra files written beside the capture. Off by default; each one is listed in the build manifest with its size and hash.

options.label: VLAN tagging
options.help: Tag every frame with an 802.1Q VLAN ID, as a trunk or SPAN port would deliver it.

params.label: Scheme
params.help: Per subnet gives each emulated network its own ID; fixed puts the whole capture on one.

params.label: Add an outer tag (QinQ)
params.help: A service tag outside the VLAN tag (802.1ad), as a provider network would add.

options.note: Adds 4 bytes to every frame (8 with QinQ), under half a percent of the capture. Replaying a tagged capture needs a sensor port that accepts tagged frames.

options.label: Flow truth file
options.help: One JSON line per flow, tagged with the scenario that produced it: what the generator put on the wire.
options.note: Adds about 5% to the capture's size (38 MB on a 773 MB capture). Measured once, at size 0.004 with every scenario.

options.label: Zeek-style ssl and x509 logs
options.help: TLS handshake and certificate logs in a Zeek-style layout, read back from the finished capture.
options.note: Adds about 1% to the capture's size (7 MB on a 773 MB capture). Measured once, at size 0.004 with every scenario.

options.label: Zeek-style http log
options.help: Plaintext HTTP requests and responses in a Zeek-style layout. Not a claim of byte-identical Zeek output.
options.note: Adds under half a percent to the capture's size (3 MB on a 773 MB capture). Measured once, at size 0.004 with every scenario.

options.label: pcapng copy
options.help: The same capture converted to pcapng, for tools that prefer it. The classic pcap stays the main output.
options.note: A second full copy: about 4% larger than the pcap (803 MB beside 773 MB). Measured once, at size 0.004 with every scenario.

options.label: IPFIX flow export
options.help: Flow records for the capture as export packets from a synthetic exporter, plus a CSV of the same records. Not tested against any flow collector.
options.note: Adds about 3.7% to the capture's size (12.6 MB pcap plus 16.4 MB CSV on a 775 MB capture). Measured once, at size 0.004 with every scenario.

options.label: NetFlow v9 flow export
options.help: Flow records for the capture as export packets from a synthetic exporter, plus a CSV of the same records. Not tested against any flow collector.
options.note: Adds about 3.1% to the capture's size (7.7 MB pcap plus 16.4 MB CSV on a 775 MB capture). Measured once, at size 0.004 with every scenario.
